data.current_description:
Sets (or, with a null / blank value, clears) the badge / HRIS id this employee is matched by in
`employee.externalId`. At most 64 characters, compared exactly as sent (case-sensitive), unique inside
your company: a value another employee already carries returns `409 already_exists` naming them.
`X-HourSquare-Dry-Run: true` checks the value without writing.

Requires scope `attendance.record` (86).
data.description_suggestion: Sets or clears the badge/HRIS external id for an employee (max 64 characters, case-sensitive, unique per company). Accepts null or blank values to clear the id. Returns `409 already_exists` if the value is already assigned to another employee. Supports dry-run validation via `X-HourSquare-Dry-Run: true` header. Returns the updated employee record with the new external id. Requires scope `attendance.record` (86).
